notes.title: PRE-ALPHA PLAYTEST
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Sometimes when you work on a game, it can become hard to have an objective opinion of what it's actually worth. It's fun for me, for sure, and for some friends, but what about other people I don't know? 
Well, this is it. The Last Catalyst has its core gameplay full functionnal, and now I need your opinion: is the game actually good? Should I invest a few more years to make it beautiful, richer, deeper? Let me know <3

(At least it's supposed to be live. I'm working on it.)
